ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  ACME Solar Holdings Limited has commissioned a 35.81 MW / 148.645 MWh Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) component in Rajasthan, with a Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) secured with Tata Power and a Commercial Operation Date (COD) set for November 22, 2026. This represents a material positive impact by expanding the company's operational renewable energy assets and securing future revenue streams. However, it is noted that only the BESS component of the larger TATA FDRE Power Project is currently operational, implying further phases are still pending.
